title: Mokuli
intro: Khale koana, matsatsing a pele a nalane ea batho, meea e 'meli e ne e eme ka pel'a 'Mōpi oa eona e nkile linyehelo. E 'ngoe e ile ea amoheloa, e 'ngoe ea se amoheloe. Se ileng sa latela e ne e tla ba tlokotsi ea pele e kholo pakeng tsa bana ba motho - ketso e le 'ngoe ea ho ithiba ka mamello le ketso e le 'ngoe ea phetetso e bohloko. Na u ka senola hore na ke mang?
clues: Ke hlahile matsatsing a pele feela a ho ba teng ha motho lefatšeng
Ke ne ke le ngoana oa batho ba pele ba ileng ba tsamaea lefatšeng lena
Ke kile ka nyehela sehlabelo se tsoang mohlapeng oa ka o motle ka ho fetisisa ho khahlisa 'Mōpi oa ka
Nyehelo ea ka e ile ea amoheloa ho tsoa holimo, ha nyehelo ea ngoan'eso e ile ea hanoa
Ha ke sokeloa ka lefu, ke ile ka khetha ho se phahamise letsoho la ka khahlanong le ngoan'eso
Ke bile motho oa pele historing eohle ea batho ea ileng a bolaoa ka phoso ke motho e mong

identity.label: Ke mang?
options: Habile (Abele), mora oa Adama
Qabil (Kaine), mora oa Adama
Adama, motho oa pele
Nuh (Noe)
Ibrahim (Abrahama)

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Polao ea pele historing ea batho
Moroallo o moholo oa Nuh
Ho timetsoa ha lebotho la Firawn
Sehlabelo sa Ismail ke Ibrahim
Ntoa khahlanong le Jalut (Goliathe)
trial.answer: Polao ea pele historing ea batho

location.label: Karolo ea Bohlokoa
options: Nku e nyeheloang e le sehlabelo se khahlisang
Areka e kholo ea lehong
Lere le ileng la fetoha noha
Nonyana e bitsoang hupoe e jereng molaetsa oa borena
Mokero o tukang oa mollo
location.answer: Nku e nyeheloang e le sehlabelo se khahlisang

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: E bile mohlaseluoa oa pele oa polao historing ea batho
O ile a pholoha moroallo o moholo ka har'a sekepe sa lehong
O phetse ka mpeng ea tlhapi e kholo
O ne a busa dijini, batho le moya
O ile a lelera ka lilemo tse mashome a mane lefeelleng le leholo
outcome.answer: E bile mohlaseluoa oa pele oa polao historing ea batho

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
